**Analytics tab overview**

- **Technical‑indicator reference thresholds** (textbook definitions, not live market data)  
  • RSI: overbought 70, oversold 30, midline 50, range‑regime band 40‑60  
  • Stochastic: overbought 80, oversold 20  
  • Williams %R: overbought ‑20, oversold ‑80  
  • CCI: overbought +100, oversold ‑100  
  • ADX trend strength: neutral 20, strong 25  
  • Bollinger Bands: ±2 standard deviations around the 20‑period moving average  
  • MACD zero line: 0 (settings 12/26/9)  
  • ATR: 14‑period calculation window  
  • 52‑week price range is displayed as a reference

- **Agent state (QuantNexus)**  
  • Status: IDLE  
  • Mode: OBSERVE  
  • Market regime: RISK_OFF with confidence 65 %  
  • Open positions: 1 of 18 allowed  
  • Portfolio heat: 0.01 % (limit 5 %)  
  • Shortlist count: 5 tickers

The tab therefore provides a set of static indicator thresholds for reference, alongside the current system status and risk limits for paper‑trading.
